description: The figure presents two line plots comparing the training rewards of two methods—Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY—across different training sets. The top plot, labeled "Easy Training Set," shows training rewards on the y-axis (ranging from 0.0 to 0.25) as a function of steps on the x-axis (ranging from 0 to 500). The Llama-On-Policy-Easy method (teal line) starts at a training reward of approximately 0.0 and steadily increases, reaching a reward of about 0.25 by step 500. The Llama-LUFFY-Easy method (red line) begins at a similar point but shows a slightly faster initial increase, peaking around step 100 at a reward of approximately 0.23 before fluctuating and stabilizing near 0.24. The shaded area around the Llama-LUFFY-Easy line suggests variability in the training process. The bottom plot, labeled "Hard Training Set," displays a similar trend but with different dynamics. The Llama-On-Policy-Hard method (teal line) starts at 0.0 and increases slowly, reaching a maximum reward of about 0.03 by step 500. In contrast, the Llama-LUFFY-Hard method (red line) begins at 0.0, rises sharply to a peak of approximately 0.22 around step 200, and then fluctuates, ending at a reward of about 0.21 at step 500. Both plots use a linear scale for both axes and display the data with solid lines and shaded uncertainty regions.
